meta.title: FL2 requirement decision-readiness register
meta.scope_note: This expanded operational checklist contains 81 atomic readiness rows. A many-to-many crosswalk in data/requirements-crosswalk.csv traces all 25 records in data/requirements.csv and all 10 grouped rows in research/requirements.md; the 81 rows are not a one-to-one replacement for those older inventories. The legacy CSV retains its original status/note claims, now labels its trailing date as recorded_date, and adds current_evidence paths. Treat the new row-level status/evidence as the current readiness view.
meta.freshness_warning: The repository Week 10 data snapshot is dated 2026-11-14. Selected live official pages were read on 2026-11-16, but the page responses were not persisted or hashed. Those later reads do not refresh, re-version, or prove byte-for-byte agreement with the local Nov 14 files; Week 10 statuses are historical, not current availability.
meta.clearance_note: Clearance measures are proposed engineering/research gates or targets, not official NFL thresholds or observed NFL values. Freeze them before evaluation. A linked official page supports only the fact and scope stated in its source note; it does not validate local coverage, model methods, or performance.
meta.source_policy: Sourceable NFL facts must link to an official NFL/club/Game Book/NWS page. Club charts remain explicitly unofficial. If no applicable official source exists, the source link is blank and the row identifies its repository-only or not-applicable evidence state; unresolved factual claims are flagged rather than inferred.
meta.source_capture_policy: checked_date_utc is a calendar date, not a retrieval timestamp. captured_at_utc and sha256 are null because no raw page response was saved. A clickable dynamic URL is not an immutable point-in-time snapshot.

status_definitions.implemented: The specific deliverable exists; this does not imply the complete NFL system is production-ready.
status_definitions.partial: Some artifact or coverage exists, but at least one stated gate remains open.
status_definitions.blocked: A required source, policy, dataset, or implementation is absent.
status_definitions.proposed: A design/request exists but is not validated as an operating system.
status_definitions.needs-review: A conflict, stale snapshot, provenance, or measurement inconsistency needs review.

evidence_state_definitions.official-direct-unarchived: The linked official page directly states the named external fact; the fetched response is not archived or hashed.
evidence_state_definitions.official-pathway-unarchived: An official page/feed is a source route or limited example, not proof of repository coverage or model validity; no response hash is saved.
evidence_state_definitions.club-unofficial-historical: A club-site chart is recorded in local historical data and is labeled unofficial there; it is not an NFL-issued depth chart or actual-starter record.
evidence_state_definitions.stale-or-conflicted: Local claims, page vintages, counts, or methods conflict or lack a matching immutable snapshot; values remain claims under review.
evidence_state_definitions.repository-only: The finding concerns local files, code, process, or product state; project references are the evidence, and no NFL source can certify it.
evidence_state_definitions.no-official-source: No applicable official NFL source can substantiate this analysis/policy requirement; the source cell is intentionally blank.
